Snapshot is authorized per crop against those receipts (Learn: section.figureCoverage.viewed dims; Exam/Tutor: assertSourceFigureView against the per-page map entry) and returns exactly one image. Multi-item fields elsewhere in the same params object establish the batch precedent: schema-level minItems/maxItems plus handler-level per-item validation with indexed errors.
